ops.title: cc-transcript/capt-hook fleet shares one cargo target dir and live working copies — build serialization, cc-guides render drift, and worktree ownership rules
ops.body:
Working in /Users/yasyf/Code/cc-transcript (and siblings) means sharing with concurrent agent sessions.

**Why:** All cargo invocations share `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=~/.cargo/shared-target` — builds from every checkout/worktree serialize on one file lock ("Blocking waiting for file lock on build directory"); another session's stub_gen/uv-sync can hold it 15+ min (udpipe C++). The main working copy carries multiple sessions' uncommitted WIP simultaneously; a teammate may `git reset --hard` a worktree they consider theirs.

**How to apply:**
- Never park on the lock; poll (`until ! pgrep …`) in background and keep working. Kill only YOUR queued builds (`pkill -f "maturin develop"` also matched another session's `maturin pep517` once — scope pkill patterns tightly).
- `cc-guides render` pulls the LATEST upstream cc-skills fragments and materializes OTHER sessions' pending local fragment edits — for an isolated change pin it: `cc-guides render --source cc-skills=github:yasyf/cc-skills@<locked-commit> --lock-version <locked-version>`, then restore the lock's `spec` line to `@main` for a byte-identical lock.
- Before editing a worktree another agent set up, confirm ownership; snapshot your diff to a /tmp patch (`git diff <base> -- <files> > /tmp/x.patch`) before any long wait — a teammate's reset-and-replay looked exactly like a mystery revert.
- cc-transcript ext dev loop: venv is a uv editable install with the .so at `cc_transcript/_native.abi3.so`; rebuild via `VIRTUAL_ENV=$PWD/.venv uvx maturin develop`; `uv run --no-sync pytest` avoids resync; `__init__.pyi` is generator-owned (`scripts/gen_export_stub.py`, needs the built ext), `_native.pyi` via `cargo run -p cc-transcript-py --bin stub_gen`.

Related: [[cct-payload-word-primitives-shipped]] [[concurrent-release-race-protocol]] [[commit-only-fully-owned-files]]
